name: MonarchConnectedAppsList
title: ConnectedAppsList
wrapsNative: MonarchCard with a androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of rows (MonarchFavicon, androidx.compose.material3.Text, MonarchBadge, android.text.format.DateUtils.getRelativeTimeSpanString, MonarchButton), androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog to confirm, MonarchLoadingState, MonarchEmptyState and MonarchErrorState
summary: The apps a person signed in to with their account: logo, name, domain, Verified and Suspended badges, when it was connected and last used, the workspace and what it can access, with Remove access behind a confirmation.
whenToUse: On an account's security or privacy screen, so people can see which apps use their account and take access back.
whenNotToUse: For the devices signed in to the account, use MonarchDeviceList. For API keys or tokens the person created, use a list of their own with MonarchSecretField.
api: @Composable fun MonarchConnectedAppsList(apps: List<MonarchConnectedApp>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, state: MonarchConnectedAppsListState = MonarchConnectedAppsListState.Ready, title: String? = null, description: String? = null, retrying: Boolean = false, confirmRevoke: Boolean = true, now: Long? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onRevoke: (suspend (MonarchConnectedApp) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchConnectedAppsListLabels = MonarchConnectedAppsListLabels())

class MonarchConnectedApp(id: String, name: String, logo: Painter? = null, domain: String? = null, verified: Boolean = false, suspended: Boolean = false, workspace: String? = null, scopes: List<String> = emptyList(), connectedAtMillis: Long? = null, lastUsedAtMillis: Long? = null)
enum class MonarchConnectedAppsListState { Ready, Loading, Error }

class MonarchConnectedAppsListLabels(listLabel: String? = null, verified: String? = null, suspended: String? = null, connected: String? = null, lastUsed: String? = null, workspace: String? = null, scopesLabel: ((String) -> String)? = null, revoke: String? = null, revokeLabel: ((String) -> String)? = null, confirmTitle: ((String) -> String)? = null, confirmMessage: String? = null, cancel: String? = null, revoked: ((String) -> String)? = null, revokeFailed: ((String) -> String)? = null, loading: String? = null, emptyTitle: String? = null, emptyMessage: String? = null, errorTitle: String? = null)

options.name: apps
options.description: The connected apps, each with a name, optional logo Painter, domain, verified and suspended flags, workspace, scopes in plain words, and connected and last-used times in epoch milliseconds.

options.name: state
options.description: Ready shows the rows, or the empty state when there are none; Loading shows placeholder rows; Error shows MonarchErrorState.

options.name: title
options.description: Replaces "Connected apps". An empty string hides the header.

options.name: description
options.description: Replaces the line under the title.

options.name: retrying
options.description: Shows the retry in progress in the error state.

options.name: confirmRevoke
options.description: Asks before removing access. Turn it off when onRevoke shows the app's own confirmation.

options.name: now
options.description: The reference time for "3 days ago", in epoch milliseconds. Without it the times follow the clock, refreshed every minute.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Retries loading. Adds Try again to the error state.

options.name: onRevoke
options.description: Removes an app's access; remove the app from apps when it returns. Adds Remove access to every row; the row's button is busy while it runs. A thrown exception's message, or a built-in sentence, is shown under the row and announced.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every other built-in string.

states.name: ready
states.description: The rows inside the card, separated by subtle dividers.

states.name: loading
states.description: Two skeleton rows from MonarchLoadingState, announced as "Loading connected apps".

states.name: error
states.description: A small MonarchErrorState with Try again when onRetry is given.

states.name: confirming
states.description: The Material 3 alert dialog asks "Remove access for Notes?" with a danger Remove access and a ghost Cancel.

states.name: removing
states.description: The row's Remove access button shows its progress indicator and reads "Loading".

states.name: removal failed
states.description: The failure in the danger strong color under the row, announced.

states.name: suspended app
states.description: The name is muted and a warning Suspended badge follows it.

appearance: A MonarchCard with the section header, rows separated by subtle dividers, names in the strong body style, domain, times and workspace in the caption style in the muted color, a success Verified badge and a warning Suspended badge, and a small danger button. All are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The parity map names a LazyColumn; the rows are a plain Column in a MonarchCard instead, because the list is short and sits inside the app's scrolling settings screen, where a LazyColumn without a fixed height cannot be measured (iOS makes the same choice). The confirmation is the Material 3 AlertDialog with MonarchButtons (the confirm dialog on Android). It closes when confirmed, so, as on iOS, the progress moves to the row's button and a failure appears under the row, where the web keeps both inside the dialog. The logo is a Painter the app loads (Monarch adds no image loader), where the web and iOS take a URL. onRevoke is a suspend function that receives the whole app, where the web passes the id. The web's SectionCard is MonarchSectionHeader inside MonarchCard; its headingLevel has no Android equivalent: the title is a heading. The web's danger-subtle button variant does not exist on Android; the danger variant is used. Times are epoch milliseconds formatted by DateUtils in the device's locale; the web's locale prop is not offered.
accessibility: The title is a heading, from MonarchSectionHeader; the list is a traversal group named "Connected apps".
Each app's name, badges, domain, times and workspace are one element: the name as its content description and the rest as its state, built by a tested pure function.
Each scope list is a group named "What Notes can access".
Remove access is a MonarchButton named "Remove access for Notes" with a 48dp touch target and a busy state; the confirmation is a Material 3 alert dialog.
Removal and failures are announced through a polite live region; a failure is also shown as text.
Badges are words, so the verified and suspended states do not depend on color.
edgeCases: A missing logo shows the first letter of the name.
An app with no times, domain or scopes shows only its name and badges.
Two removals can run at once; each row tracks its own progress and failure.
Long names wrap and the badges move to the next line.
A removal that is still running when the list leaves the screen is cancelled with it.

examples.title: Remove access
examples.setupTemplate:
var apps by remember {
    mutableStateOf(
        listOf(
            MonarchConnectedApp(
                id = {{apps.0.id}},
                name = {{apps.0.name}},
                domain = {{apps.0.domain}},
                verified = {{apps.0.verified}},
                workspace = {{apps.0.workspace}},
                scopes = listOf({{apps.0.scopes.0}}, {{apps.0.scopes.1}}),
                connectedAtMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - {{apps.0.connectedDaysAgo}} * 86_400_000L,
                lastUsedAtMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - {{apps.0.lastUsedDaysAgo}} * 86_400_000L,
            ),
            MonarchConnectedApp(
                id = {{apps.1.id}},
                name = {{apps.1.name}},
                domain = {{apps.1.domain}},
                scopes = listOf({{apps.1.scopes.0}}),
                connectedAtMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - {{apps.1.connectedDaysAgo}} * 86_400_000L,
                lastUsedAtMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - {{apps.1.lastUsedDaysAgo}} * 86_400_000L,
            ),
            MonarchConnectedApp(
                id = {{apps.2.id}},
                name = {{apps.2.name}},
                suspended = {{apps.2.suspended}},
                connectedAtMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - {{apps.2.connectedDaysAgo}} * 86_400_000L,
            ),
        ),
    )
}
examples.setup:
var apps by remember {
    mutableStateOf(
        listOf(
            MonarchConnectedApp(
                id = "app-1",
                name = "Notes",
                domain = "notes.example.com",
                verified = true,
                workspace = "Design team",
                scopes = listOf("See your name and profile picture", "See your email address"),
                connectedAtMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - 40 * 86_400_000L,
                lastUsedAtMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - 1 * 86_400_000L,
            ),
            MonarchConnectedApp(
                id = "app-2",
                name = "Planner",
                domain = "planner.example.org",
                scopes = listOf("See your name and profile picture"),
                connectedAtMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - 200 * 86_400_000L,
                lastUsedAtMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - 90 * 86_400_000L,
            ),
            MonarchConnectedApp(
                id = "app-3",
                name = "Survey tool",
                suspended = true,
                connectedAtMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - 12 * 86_400_000L,
            ),
        ),
    )
}
